content.text: {"id": "mm5610a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The gonorrhea rate among males in the eight states increased 46.7%, from 64.3 per 100,000 in 2000 to 94.5 in 2005."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "At 15 public health laboratories in the eight nonwestern states used for comparison, the number of tests increased 13.8%"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "increased 52.0%, from 56.3 cases per 100,000 population in 2000 to 85.6 cases per 100,000 in 2005"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The percentage of samples tested using NAATs increased from 49% in 2000 to 86% in 2004"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The overall gonorrhea rate for the eight western states increased 52.0%"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "At 15 public health laboratories in the eight nonwestern states used for comparison, the number of tests increased 13.8%"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "rates in the three other U.S. regions decreased (South: -22%, Northeast: -16%, and Midwest: -5%)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "This report describes the epidemiology of gonorrhea in eight western states that reported large increases"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "from 2000 to 2005, rates in the West* increased 42%"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "were imputed on the basis of proportions from case reports that contained known data"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "were compared with data from the eight nonwestern states that reported the highest gonorrhea rates in 2005"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": []}
